Context: 1. Reservation for SCs/ST s

- OM, dated 29-3-2023.  
While recruiting candidates belonging to OBC community, there may be no objection in accepting caste/ community certificate in any of the scheduled languages in addition to the official language. State/ UT Governments may make available a digital copy of such certificates online for verification by recruiting organizations. - OM, dated 13-4-2023.
